publicReleaseNotes: Platter prepares its first installable listing with hosted deployment metadata, Managed mail support, a mail-off mode (MAIL_PROVIDER=none, owner sign-in with rer signin) and retained source provenance. It provides two-option proposals, owner approval, email-verified acceptance and deposit invoice export. See CONTRACT.md for published guarantees and unfinished target work.

agentUpdateInstructions: Use the pinned rer commands and the committed setup manifest. Review deployment inputs and recovery instructions before installation.

HTTP-001.summary: Every proposal, client, import and invoice handler checks a native Base owner or member session, or a revocable owner-bound agent key, before it reads or writes.

ACCESS-001.summary: An owner issues an agent key with a label and a 30-day expiry, stored only as a hash and bound to that owner's current account version.

PROP-001.summary: Every approval names one exact revision.

PROP-002.summary: Sending freezes the approved revision: its scope, options and prices can no longer be edited in place.

SIGN-001.summary: A client invitation grants access only to its own frozen offer.

SIGN-002.summary: Acceptance requires a verified mailbox, a typed full name, one offered option and explicit consent.

INV-001.summary: An owner exports the accepted deposit as an invoice record.

IMPORT-001.summary: The client CSV kit previews the exact source bytes without writing, and applies only the file whose fingerprint was reviewed.

ERASE-001.summary: An owner erases a client by typing the exact client name.

PORT-001.summary: RER archives preserve clients, proposals, revisions, approvals, immutable acceptances and deposit invoices.

MAIL-001.summary: Local proposal and verification mail is captured without a provider.

SITE-001.summary: The public run site is built with `rer build --site`.
